Re : CRAN 4555 of 2017 This is an application for suspension of sentence imposed on the appellants by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Second FTC, Jalpaiguri in Sessions Case No.93 of 2006 (T.R. No.30 of 2006), holding the appellants guilty of offence punishable under Section 376(2)(g) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 363 as well as Section 366A of the Indian Penal Code.
The appellants/petitioners say that they have almost served out the sentence and the sentence would be completed on October 18, 2024.
They wanted to withdraw the appeal.

We cannot permit the appellants/petitioners to withdraw the appeal since a Rule was issued by a coordinate Bench calling upn the appellants to show cause as to why the sentence should not be enhanced.

sentences.text: We need to dispose of that Rule.
It is not possible to do so immediately since we are only two days away from the long vacation.
However, we find that the appeal was filed in the year 2016.
More than 8 years have gone by.
The appeal is still pending.
The appellants are in custody.

Following the ratio laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Kashmira Singh Vs. The State of Punjab reported at 1977 (4) Supreme Court Cases 291, which has been consistently followed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court and naturally by the other courts, only on the ground of lengthy detention, we enlarge the appellants/petitioners on bail.

entities.text: Kashmira Singh Vs. The State of Punjab reported at 1977 (4) Supreme Court Cases 291
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, we direct that the appellants/petitioners, namely, Babulal Sahani and Sankar Sahani,
shall be released on bail upon furnishing bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) each, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalpaiguri.
The appellants/petitioners shall appear on each and every date of hearing of this appeal.

The appellants/petitioners shall not leave the jurisdiction of the local police station except for the purpose of attending the hearing of the appeal and shall report to the Officer-in-Charge/Inspector-in-Charge of Bhaktinagar Police Station once in a week, until further orders.

In the event the appellants/petitioners fail to comply with any of the conditions stipulated above without any justifiable cause, the learned trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel their bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.

Signed By :
DEBAJYOTI DAS High Court of Calcutta 4 th of October 2024 06:20:20 PM
The application being CRAN 4555 of 2017 is, thus, disposed of.
Let the appeal be listed for hearing after the ensuing Puja Vacation.
All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Criminal Section is directed to supply certified copies of this order to the parties, if applied for, upon compliance of all necessary formalities.

(Arijit Banerjee, J.) (Apurba Sinha Ray, J.) Signed By :
